messages.text: Waiver wire closes at 3 today right? I need a running back badly. Two of mine are on bye or hurt and I'm staring at a lineup that looks like a bad credit desk.
Waivers run until 3 ET I think, but the order resets based on standings. You're 5-1 so you're picking dead last, Steven. Enjoy the scraps.
Dead last is still better than your 1-5. Travis, your team name should be 'Merge Conflict' at this point.
It literally is Merge Conflict. And it's 2-4, thank you. Rebuilding year.
Reminder for anyone who hasn't set a lineup: Thursday night game kicks off at 8:15. I got burned last week by leaving a questionable guy in. Never again.
Nadia that was me last week, started a kicker who was inactive. Zero points. Lost by 3. I'm still not over it.
Greg, a zero from the kicker slot is the most painful way to lose. We've all been there. Check the inactives list an hour before kickoff, it saves lives.
Quick poll for the league: are we doing the trade deadline on Oct 28 or pushing it a week? Some of us have been traveling and haven't had time to negotiate.
Push it a week, please. I'm trying to pry a receiver away from Hannah and she keeps ghosting my offers.
Cassandra I'm not ghosting, your offers are just insulting. A third-string tight end and a handshake is not a package.
Fine, I'll sweeten it. Counter incoming with a decent flex player. Check your app after lunch.
I'm fine either way on the deadline, but vote for the extra week. More chaos is more fun. Also someone needs to enforce the rule about no collusion trades.
Extra week gets my vote too. That makes it 3 for pushing, 0 against so far.
Unrelated but important: who's bringing snacks for the draft recap party? Last time it was just one sad bag of pretzels.
I can bring a few boxes of cookies. Someone else needs to cover actual food. Greg, you owe us for that kicker disaster.
Ha, fair. I'll grab pizza. Two large, one plain, one veggie so nobody complains.
Update: 4 votes for pushing the deadline to Nov 4. I'll change the league setting tonight. Please keep an eye on your waiver claims before 3!
Thanks Hannah. Placing my claim now. If I miss out on the running back, I'm blaming Travis's waiver priority.
Steven, my priority is better than yours, that's the one thing I've got going. Good luck out there.
